reference.text: Mrs. Spencer lived in a big yellow house at White Sands Cove, and she came to the door with surprise and welcome mingled on her benevolent face.
“Why, Robert sent word down by his daughter Nancy and she said you wanted a girl—didn’t she, Flora Jane?”

underlines.text: sitting mutely on the ottoman, with her hands clasped tightly in her lap

reference.text: Anne, you sit here on the ottoman and don’t wriggle.

underlines.text: suppose I might as well take her off your hands, Miss Cuthbert
